name: R14.3 Chase overdue actions and carry them into the next agenda

nodes.name: Step 1: Early each working day
nodes.notes: Early each day; step 1's rule skips weekends and holidays.

nodes.name: Step 8: Each Friday
nodes.notes: Step 8: the Friday comparison and count. No Friday count by noon means the run never fired.

nodes.name: Step 9: Meeting decisions recorded
nodes.notes: Your agenda list calls this after each meeting, once the chair has recorded decisions. Body: {meeting_id}.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Edit these values for your company; nothing else in the workflow hard-codes them.

nodes.name: Steps 2 to 8: Rules
nodes.notes: Rules decide; there is no AI step in R14.3. It never moves a date, reassigns or closes a task.

parameters.query: WITH reserved AS (INSERT INTO key_log (recipe, key, status) VALUES ($1, $2, 'in progress') ON CONFLICT (recipe, key) DO NOTHING RETURNING key), skipped AS (UPDATE key_log SET copies_skipped = copies_skipped + 1 WHERE recipe = $1 AND key = $2 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reserved)) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM reserved) = 1 AS is_new, $2::text AS key

nodes.name: Step 3: Reserve reminder key
nodes.notes: Key log: refuses a second copy in the same step (book Chapter 2).

nodes.name: Reminder key logged: stop
nodes.notes: This verified date has a reminder already, or one in flight.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ to: [$('Steps 2 to 8: Rules').item.json.owner_email], subject: 'Overdue action: ' + $('Steps 2 to 8: Rules').item.json.title, text: $('Steps 2 to 8: Rules').item.json.title + ' was due ' + $('Steps 2 to 8: Rules').item.json.due_date + ' (' + $('Steps 2 to 8: Rules').item.json.series + '). Source: ' + $('Steps 2 to 8: Rules').item.json.source_link }) }}

nodes.name: Step 4: Remind the owner
nodes.notes: One reminder for each agreed date; the next step is a meeting, never a second message.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO exception_queue (recipe, item, reason, detail, owner) SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, $5 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exception_queue WHERE recipe = $1 AND item = $2 AND status = 'open') RETURNING id

options.queryReplacement: ={{ ["R14.3", $('Steps 2 to 8: Rules').item.json.key, "reminder key pending", 'The reminder may have been sent but was never marked sent; it is not resent. Release or close the key.', $('Config').first().json.exception_owner] }}

nodes.name: Step 4: Pending key: Owen checks
nodes.notes: A "pending" key is never resent; one open exception per key.

parameters.query: WITH reserved AS (INSERT INTO key_log (recipe, key, status) VALUES ($1, $2, 'in progress') ON CONFLICT (recipe, key) DO NOTHING RETURNING key), skipped AS (UPDATE key_log SET copies_skipped = copies_skipped + 1 WHERE recipe = $1 AND key = $2 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reserved)) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM reserved) = 1 AS is_new, $2::text AS key
